title: 第11章 全力研究她的特产第12章 修仙界也有职场霸凌
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
汇报会议里，李局面色凝重的将李婉的回信复述出来，听完汇报的东国首脑长叹一口气，“事情还是往最难控制的方向发展了。”
“李婉同志果然是去到了另外的一个世界。”
李婉上个月传信的那块衣服碎片上承载的信息，早就被国家智库们研究了个透彻，其中不少人的观点就是，她被未知的时空漩涡吸入到了另外一个未知的世界。
这也就代表着依国家现行的力量，无法将她救出，帮她回家。
“照李婉信里所说，那是个修行人皆有伟力的世界，我担心......”
“你担心，他们随着时空漩涡发现我们的世界？”
“这不无可能。”
“我不否认你这个观点，但我想，现阶段不太需要太过杞人忧天，这份跨界快递已经进行过了两次，我们的世界依旧照常运行，没有出现任何来自异世界窥探的迹象，
或许这种跨界的连接本身就存在某种限制，或者说，我们与那个修仙世界之间的距离，远比我们想象的更加遥远，暂时无需过度恐慌。”
“当务之急，是集中所有资源，全力研究李婉同志所寄回的‘特产’，我坚信，这将是颠覆现行力量体系的关键钥匙。”
“是！”
李局这边在开会。
基地里其他人也没闲着，符咒小组的人员看着厚厚一沓的符咒两眼放光，这么多样品，够他们做好多实验了！
基地里最德高望重的常老更是亲自带队研究刚刚放进低温冰箱保存的朱火灵果，那袋种子也被东国顶尖农业大学博士后的团队接手。
一切都在井井有条的进行着，王芬、李志强正和工作人员将这次的回信放入盒中。
自从知道黑盒子可以拒收，拒收后黑盒子会带着盒子里的东西回去后，这一个月里，基地都在想该给李婉寄什么实用的回去。
开了好几次会后，基于黑盒子的大小，最终定下回寄的东西。
根据这次李婉给的消息产生的疑问信件，李爸李妈的家书，女孩贴身的内衣裤以及卫生巾等女性用品和还有常备药品，回寄的物品中最重要的一部分东西是武器。
此次共寄了两样武器，分别是一把锋利的匕首，消音枪和子弹。
“我点退货了啊。”李婉妈妈看着盒子里那张粉色信笺，那是她和乐乐爸爸对女儿最诚挚的想念。

李局站在一旁，眼神沉沉的看着屋子中央的黑盒，“点。”
如老式电视雪花般闪烁了几下后，黑盒子消失在了原地，就在黑盒子消失的下一秒，空中突兀的掉出两件东西来。
众人凝神一看，正是那把匕首和手枪。
黑盒不能运送武器么？
李局将这点记在心中，打算等下个月的时候问问李婉那边的情况。
从李婉之前传回的信息中，基地已经知道这个快递系统一个月才能寄一次，且这个可以跨越时空的快递并非修仙界的产物，而是在李婉穿越之初就与她绑定。
来历不明...
李局疲惫的揉了揉鼻梁，觉得自己被困在一张厚厚的密网中。
李婉活力满满的从床上爬起，她昨天晚上已经透……
又是新的一天！
李婉活力满满的从床上爬起，她昨天晚上已经透过月光看过了这次老家回寄给她的东西。
每一样都深得她心。
爸爸妈妈的家书看得她热泪盈眶，她长这么大，还是第一次离家这么久，心里早就想家人朋友了，不过她爱面子，即使想念也不好意思在信里说。
content_en:
During the reporting meeting, Director Li recounted Li Wan's reply with a solemn expression. After listening to the report, the head of Dongguo sighed deeply, "Things are still developing in the direction that is most difficult to control."
"Comrade Li Wan has indeed gone to another world."
The information carried on the piece of clothing that Li Wan sent last month has been thoroughly studied by national think tanks. Many of them believe that she was sucked into another unknown world by an unknown vortex of time and space.
This also means that according to the current power of the country, it is impossible to rescue her and help her return home.
"According to what Li Wanxin said, it is a world where practitioners have great power. I'm worried..."
"Are you worried that they will discover our world through the vortex of time and space?"
"It's not impossible."
"I don't deny your point of view, but I think there is no need to be too unreasonable at this stage. This cross-border express delivery has been carried out twice, and our world is still running as usual, without any signs of prying eyes from other worlds.
Perhaps this cross-border connection itself has some limitations, or in other words, the distance between us and the world of immortality is far further than we imagined, so there is no need to panic for the time being. "
"The top priority is to concentrate all resources and study the 'specialties' sent back by Comrade Li Wan. I firmly believe that this will be the key to subverting the current power system."
"Yes!"
Director Li is having a meeting here.
Others in the base were not idle either. The staff of the spell team looked at the thick pile of spells and their eyes lit up. These many samples were enough for them to conduct many experiments!
Chang Lao, the most respected person in the base, even personally led a team to study the Zhuhuo Lingguo that had just been stored in a low-temperature refrigerator. The bag of seeds was also taken over by a postdoctoral team from Dongguo's top agricultural university.
Everything is going on in an orderly manner. Wang Fen, Li Zhiqiang and the staff are putting this reply into the box.
Ever since they learned that the black box can be rejected and that the black box will take the contents back with it after rejection, the base has been thinking about what practical things to send back to Li Wan in the past month.
After several meetings, based on the size of the black box, we finally decided what to send back.
According to the question letters generated by the news sent by Li Wan this time, the family letters of Li's father and mother, girls' underwear, sanitary napkins and other female products, as well as regular medicines, the most important part of the items sent back are weapons.
A total of two weapons were sent this time, namely a sharp dagger, silenced gun and bullets.
"I ordered the return." Li Wan's mother looked at the pink letter in the box. It was the most sincere thought she and Lele's father had for their daughter.
Director Li stood aside, looking at the black box in the center of the room with a heavy look, "Click."
After flickering for a few times like snowflakes on an old-fashioned TV, the black box disappeared. The next second after the black box disappeared, two things suddenly fell out of the air.
Everyone took a closer look and saw that it was the dagger and pistol.
Can't black boxes transport weapons?
Director Li kept this in mind and planned to ask Li Wan about the situation next month.
From the information Li Wan sent back before, the base already knows that this express delivery system can only deliver once a month, and that this express delivery that can span time and space is not a product of the world of immortality, but was bound to Li Wan at the beginning of her time travel.
Unknown origin...
Director Li rubbed the bridge of his nose tiredly, feeling that he was trapped in a thick network.
Li Wan got up from the bed full of energy. She had already revealed last night...
It’s a new day!
Li Wan got up from the bed full of energy. She had already read through the moonlight last night what her hometown had sent her this time.
Everything won her heart.
Reading the letters from her parents brought tears to her eyes. This was the first time in her life that she had been away from home for so long. She had long missed her family and friends, but she loved face, even if she missed themI was too embarrassed to say it in the letter.
